question: Do low-dimensional non-imagery subject covariates (ROI anatomy; perception-task recognition behavior) explain the subject-specific target-state geometry RESIDUAL left by the frozen O2.11 perception-only prior?
core_principle: predict COVARIATE -> ERROR OF THE FROZEN PERCEPTION PRIOR (not full geometry from scratch): freeze O2.11 prediction; donor residual DELTA_G_d = G_ORACLE_d - G_PRIOR_d; covariate barycentric weights predict target residual correction; test vs matched covariate<->residual-geometry permutation null

covariate_family_A_anatomy.source: NSD FreeSurfer streams parcel; ventral=label5, lateral=label6 (identical to functional s2_roi.py)

covariate_family_B_behavior.task: NSD main continuous-recognition ONLY (no imagery-task behavior)

covariate_freeze: covariate_manifest.csv + covariates.json + anatomy/behavior_provenance.json committed with per-file SHA256 BEFORE geometry (commit 264cf29); no post-outcome correction
missing_data_rule: primary family requires all 8; if any covariate not provenance-valid -> COVARIATE_FAMILY_TECHNICALLY_INCONCLUSIVE; NO impute/substitute/cohort-mean/silent-N-reduction

loso_standardization.per_feature_donor_only: mu_D, sd_D over 7 donors; z=(x-mu_D)/sd_D for donors+target; if donor sd~0 -> family non-evaluable for that LOSO target

frozen_prior.reuse: EXACT O2.11 Stage-A predictions (207b0bf); anchor-space G_PRIOR_s_IN=Q_pred_in Q_pred_in^T, G_PRIOR_s_OUT=Q_pred_out Q_pred_out^T; hash-verified

geometry.training_ids: 10 outer-training imagery identities only; 2 outer-test globally excluded
geometry.G_ORACLE_d: donor own full-resource anchor subspace (dt-free): within T_in=orth(A_d @ (W_d @ within_basis(delta_native@W_d, r))); outside T_out=orth(E_d @ outside_basis)

barycentric.objective: min_w ||x_s - sum_d w_d x_d||^2 s.t. w>=0, sum w=1
barycentric.secondary: among primary-optimal (SSE tie tol 1e-12*max(1,minSSE)) minimize ||w||^2; final tie lexicographically smallest active set
barycentric.solver: enumerate all 127 non-empty donor active sets; deterministic float64 KKT equality-constrained LS; no hyperparameter

target_lift.reuse: EXACT O2.10 certified target carrier (no new transport)

matched_null.permute: ONLY donor residual-geometry labels DELTA_G_d -> DELTA_G_pi(d)

native_eval.R_PRIOR: frozen O2.11 prior native retention (from B_IN_PRED/B_OUT_PRED)

primary_inference.family: 2 families x 2 components x 2 ROIs = EXACTLY 8 tests

support_rule: COVARIATE_RESIDUAL_COUPLING_SUPPORTED iff ALL: median E_NATIVE>0; >=6/8 E_NATIVE>0; Holm reject; median DELTA_OVER_PRIOR_NATIVE>0; >=6/8 DELTA_OVER_PRIOR_NATIVE>0 (no 0.50 recovery threshold)

program_status.SUBJECT_SPECIFIC_GEOMETRY_HAS_REPRODUCIB: >=1 frozen family supported in BOTH primary ROIs
program_status.NO_REPRODUCIBLE_TESTED_COVARIATE_STRUCTU: no primary family/component supported in either ROI

pairwise_diagnostic.geometry_dist: projector distance of residual target-state geometry

donor_sensitivity.leave-one-donor-out: recompute correction; report change in geometry sim + native retention

claim_boundaries.anatomy_positive: pre-specified ROI anatomical covariates predicted a reproducible portion of the subject-specific geometry residual left by the frozen perception-only prior
claim_boundaries.behavior_positive: individual differences in perception-task continuous-recognition behavior carried predictive information about a portion of the subject-specific geometry residual
behavior_forbidden: behavior is imagery ability (it is perception-task recognition)

cohort_limitation: N=8; each LOSO uses 7 donors; any positive is small-cohort evidence requiring external replication; a negative does NOT establish absence of all possible non-imagery predictors

two_stage.STAGE_A: freeze covariate manifest + verify provenance + donor-only standardization + anatomy & behavior weights + donor residual geometry + corrected target geometry + target lift + hash + commit + push + server-verify; NO target imagery
two_stage.STAGE_B: after Stage-A seal: verify hashes; open target oracle geometry; geometry metrics; open held-out target imagery; matched label-permutation null; E_NATIVE; exact 8-test signflip/Holm; classification; seal

next_gate.REPRODUCIBLE_NONIMAGERY_COVARIATE_STRUCT: O2.14 COVARIATE-AUGMENTED PRIOR CALIBRATION FRONTIER (freeze supported relationships; O2.11 prior + covariate correction as new fixed non-imagery prior; repeat O2.12 sub-eight cells M2T1/M2T2/M4T1/M6T1; does calibration drop below 8)
next_gate.NO_REPRODUCIBLE_STRUCTURE: O2.14 TARGET-IMAGERY CALIBRATION NECESSITY / ROBUSTNESS (no high-capacity N=8 predictor; consolidate whether direct target imagery remains necessary and how robust the 8-obs minimum is)

O3_policy: O3 remains locked regardless of O2.13 outcome
